    static long[] f = new long[Maxn];
    static long[][] t = new long[20][Maxn];
    static long[] fac = new long[Maxn], inv = new long[Maxn];
    static int[][] tmp1 = new int[20][Maxn], tmp2 = new int[20][Maxn], tmp3 = new int[20][Maxn];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();
        long pp = 1L * p * p;

            tmp2[ct[i]][i] = inv[i];

            }

    static long fastPow(long x, int y) {
        long ans = 1L;
        long now = x;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) != 0) ans = (ans * now) % p;
            now = (now * now) % p;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static void init() {
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxi; i++) {
            fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % p;
        }
        inv[maxi] = fastPow(fac[maxi], p - 2);
        for (int i = maxi - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p;
        }
    }

    static int lower(int x) {
        int tmp = 1;
        while (tmp < x) tmp <<= 1;
        return tmp;
    }

    static void FWT(int[] now, int len, boolean type) {
        long[] T = t[0];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) T[i] = now[i];
        if (type) {
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {

                    }

            }

                    for (int k = j; k < i + j; k++) {
                        T[i + k] += T[k];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            now[i] = (int) (T[i] % p);
            if (now[i] < 0) now[i] += p;
        }
    }

    static void __a(long[] x) {
        for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
            if (x[i] >= pp) x[i] -= pp;
        }
    }

    static void multi() {

            Arrays.fill(tmp1[j], 0);
            Arrays.fill(t[j], 0);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= maxi; j++) {
            tmp1[ct[j]][j] = f[j];
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++) {
            FWT(tmp1[j], maxi + 1, false);
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int l = 0; l + q <= 19; l++) {

                }

        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxi; s++) {
                tmp3[q][s] = (int) (t[q][s] % p);
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++) {
            FWT(tmp3[j], maxi + 1, true);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= maxi; j++) {
            f[j] = tmp3[ct[j]][j];
        }
    }

    static void multi2() {
        int[][] tmp = new int[20][Maxn];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {

        }
